# Ema Sedlić

> Biotech, business, and beyond. Croatia, 21 y/o. Eldest of five sisters.

Final-year double-degree student at the University of Rijeka: Biotechnology and Drug Research (2023–2027) and Business Economics, Entrepreneurship (2024–2028). Applying to the MSc Bioentrepreneurship at Karolinska Institutet for 2027. Focus: AI in medicine, digital health, bioentrepreneurship. Not interested in traditional pharma or clinical research tracks.

- Founder, KSI — Klub Solidarnosti i Inovacija, youth NGO (2023)
